subject: general
question: What is measured in 'joules'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Energy__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Energy is the ability to perform tasks**.
 
• It could exist in several different forms, such as potential, kinetic, thermal, electrical, chemical, radioactive, etc.
 
• The quantity that is transferred to a body or a physical system is **called energy.**
 
• The amount of energy expended when a force of **one newton is applied across a displacement of one metre is known as a joule. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** watt (W), **which is equal to one joule per second, is the unit of power in the International System of Units.
 
• The unit of force most frequently measured is **"Newtons," or simply "N."**
 
• m/s is the SI unit for** velocity (meters per second). **
